profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Since I was little, my grandfather would tell me stories of how he used a program called COBOL to create a satellite and send it into space. The satellite he helped create may have crashed into the moon(on purpose), but my interest and love for computer programming sky-rocketed. 

After receiving my Bachelor of Science, I took a role working for the VP of Information Security at Groupon. It sparked that interest in programming I had when I was little. I loved learning the ins and outs of cybersecurity, and how programming protects vulnerable populations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Attending a 4 week classroom environment learn how to develop dynamic web-based software systems using the C# programming language and platform including:

- Object-Oriented Programming: C#
- Development tools and techniques: Agile, Unit Testing, TDD, Unix Command Line navigation, Git, Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
-Developed testing, deploying, and iteratively improving product capabilities and
features in collaboration with designers, product managers, and other
engineers on the product team
-Leveraged critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices
to achieve desired business outcomes
-Developed high quality applications that are secure, easy to operate, difficult to
break, and extremely observable with measurable results.
-Responsible for all technical aspects of the product application lifecycle
including, code, infrastructure, data, security, and CICD
-Contributed to product engineering and software standards
-Continuously developed self and supported the development of others

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
-Virtual Vending Machine: Created a Command Line Program vending machine utilizing object-oriented programming principles and File I/O.
-TEnmo Payments Software: Programmed an API server using the Spring Boot framework and PostgreSQL. Implemented the DAO pattern; used jdbcTemplate for queries and restTemplate for HTTP requests in a Venmo-like app.
-Rome Around City Tours: Incorporated Google Maps API into our application using Java, Javascript, HTML & CSS. User was able to create an itinerary on the website and using Google API could search through a curated list we create in our database.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
-Coordinated global implementation of multi-factor authentication using physical security tokens for third-party vendors.
-Lead project to lapse over 1500 company domains, saving the company $20,000.
-Captained the Sustainable Security team comprising 8 people. Tracked deliverables and assisted the team to maintain compliance with GDPR and CCPA privacy laws.
-Managed high-volume calendaring for the Vice President of Information Security, Chief of Staff, and Chief Architect.
-Arranged extensive domestic and international travel.
-Planned multinational events and off-sites for various teams.
-Created purchase orders and processed expense reimbursements.
-Managed executives’ inboxes to prioritize and filter “noise” email. 
-Created key contact reference sheets, annual meeting planners, and meeting agendas.
-Managed documentation for internal interview performance evaluation program with 70+ participants.

positions.title: Office Coordinator
positions.description:
-Managed multiple calendars on Google Calendars.
-Greeted candidates and visitors while implementing procedures to ensure safety.
-Coordinated social and internal programming events for 200+ employees.
-Coordinated on boarding for new hires and ensuring the correct information for success.

positions.title: Strategic Relations and Worksite Wellness Intern
positions.description:
Analyzed diagnostic tests. 
Developed comprehensive Microsoft Excel models outlining financial projections.
Managed $120,000 project and assessing numbers for billing.
Coordinated with a strategic team to promote employer health and wellness
Incorporated population health models into worksite screenings, education, and electronic database tracking.
Screened 1,700 patients for worksite wellness program.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched to see if an irrigation project can be successful in Lumbisi, Ecuador. Lumbisi is a native community, protected and ruled under Ecuadorian Indigenous Communities Law. We are partnered with Engineers Without Boarders and the natives of Lumbisi.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Analyzed effectiveness of physical activity implementation in 100 schools all across Illinois
Conducted literature reviews of peer-reviewed research and utilize statistical regression software
Collected data from accelerometer device on grade school children and analyzed using SPSS
Transcribed 40 interviews with grade school children about their physical activity

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Boneyard Creek Community Day. 
-Helped clean up litter, removed non-native plants, and marked storm drains.
Support the class two times per week by working with students on assignments.
